candidate.raw_translation: For periodic compounding, APY = (ZXQPH0000QXZ + APR ÷ m)^m − ZXQPH0001QXZ, inda m shine adadin lokutan haɗawa a kowace shekara. Don canza APY baya zuwa APR mai suna, yi amfani da APR = m × ((ZXQPH0002QXZ + APY)^(ZXQPH0003QXZ/m) − ZXQPH0004QXZ). Ƙarƙashin haɗawa yana amfani da APY = e^APR − ZXQPH0005QXZ. Ka shigar da adadin kamar kashi; misali, ZXQPH0006QXZ yana nufin ZXQPH0007QXZ.
candidate.source: For periodic compounding, APY = (1 + APR ÷ m)^m − 1, where m is the number of compounding periods per year. To convert APY back to nominal APR, use APR = m × ((1 + APY)^(1/m) − 1). Continuous compounding uses APY = e^APR − 1. Enter rates as percentages; for example, 12 means 12%.
